study: Paper B reviewer response — sub-chance AUROC uncertainty
primary_claim: Mahalanobis OOD detection on pad_heldout inverts below chance (AUROC < 0.5)

fitzpatrick17k.caveat: No patient IDs; intervals likely anti-conservative (narrow) vs true sampling uncertainty.

bootstrap_protocol.mahalanobis_fit: ISIC train only, fixed full train set (not bootstrapped)

outputs.mean_auroc_across_seeds: 95% percentile CI on mean AUROC over seeds at each lambda
outputs.per_seed_ci: 95% percentile CI per seed; count k/5 with entire CI below 0.5

decision_rules.condition: At lambda=2, pooled (mean-across-seeds) 95% CI entirely below 0.5 AND k>=3 of 5 per-seed CIs entirely below 0.5 for primary detector (Mahalanobis) on pad_heldout
decision_rules.manuscript: Keep 'inverts below chance'; report interval wherever the claim appears

decision_rules.condition: Pooled CI below 0.5 but fewer than 3 per-seed CIs entirely below 0.5
decision_rules.manuscript: Report both; soften to 'inverts on average, with seed-level variation'

decision_rules.condition: Pooled 95% CI straddles 0.5 for Mahalanobis pad_heldout at lambda=2
decision_rules.manuscript: Remove 'inverts' from title, abstract, conclusions; claim 'falls toward chance'

secondary_scope.name: HAM to BCN same-modality reverse (Phase 16B rev)
secondary_scope.note: Bootstrap with lesion-level resample on BCN held-out; reported separately for Section 4.8 scope claim (~0.683 at lambda=1)
